title: Read complete task snapshots through the hardened local Git owner
outcome: Supply the explicit cold audit with exact complete Git snapshots without inventing a legacy exchange intent or reading worktree files.
acceptance: A read-only complete-snapshot library seam uses the existing hardened command/query, exact full commit validation, ordinary mode/canonical task path and strict document/disclosure/graph validation owners.

It returns exact commit/tree/parents and raw commit comparison plus complete typed task documents and explicitly unverified envelope metadata, with bounded named refusals and no ref/index/worktree/store mutation.

Behavioral fixtures cover complete 2000-task capture, merge/empty snapshot, SHA object-format exactness, unsafe modes/paths, malformed envelopes/documents and per-blob/aggregate bounds; parent executes focused checks before integration.

completion.summary: Landed on master in eecabd6a as part of the dd205 restart set: the read-only complete-snapshot reader (src/task_sync/git/snapshot.rs) with its fixtures (src/task_sync/git/delta/tests/snapshot.rs), carried unchanged from e530. An independent evaluation (Codex session-18627, delegation-2a36c918) on the clean eecabd6a worktree found all 3 criteria passed. Closed by Engram::Opus as dd205 integrator per Fable #4432.
